page.overview:
Who is Epokhus?

Epokhus was a son of Lykurgus of Arkadia. Epochus participated in the Kalydonian Boar Hunt together with his brother Ankaeus: Pausanias describes a painting in the Tegean temple of Athena Alea, which portrays, among others, Epokhus supporting Ankaeus who had been wounded by the boar.
